subject: Enablement transit plan — streaming + tool-calls + structured outputs
messages:
From: Roberto Vega <r.vega@healthnest.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2028 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: HealthNest -> Redwood: kickoff request and scope clarifications

Hi Grace / Monica —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re excited to move from evaluation to a scoped enablement. A couple of things we need to align on up front so procurement and engineering can plan:

- We need streaming + function/tool calling in our voice-to-text pipeline (real-time transcription + external tool call to our adjudication service).
- Structured outputs must conform to our event JSON schema (we have an existing schema but can adapt).
- Security checklist: SOC2 evidence + runtime network rules (we will share a firewall egress list).
- Timeline constraint: procurement wants a signed SOW by end of July.

Could you share a short mutual action plan (deliverables, owners, dates) and a proposed kickoff agenda? Also looping in contracts: contracts@healthnest.com for coordination on SOW/PO.

Thanks — Roberto
Roberto Vega
Head of Platform Integrations, HealthNest
rob.vega@healthnest.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Roberto Vega <r.vega@healthnest.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2028 13:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: HealthNest -> Redwood: kickoff request and scope clarifications

Roberto —

Appreciate the clear list. I attached a 1-page scope doc and a starter mutual action plan so procurement and Eng can see dates/owners. High level proposal:

- Week 0 (kickoff): alignment on security and network requirements, introduce implementation leads.
- Week 1–2 (integration spike): sample streaming session, validate tool-call surface, and share initial JSON schema crosswalk.
- Week 3 (validation): test harness run with your adjudication endpoint; iterate on structured output fields.
- Week 4 (pilot): run scaled pilot with monitoring and guardrails.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2 Jul or Thu 4 Jul, 60min. Agenda: introductions, success criteria, SOW outline, security owners, schedule.

Attachments: onboarding-scope.pdf (1pg), mutual-action-plan.csv (editable).

I’ll also include Monica (Implementation lead) and Marissa (CS lead) to drive the MAP and SOW.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Grace —

Thanks, that looks good. Contracts here are: contracts@healthnest.com (please send SOW draft once the MAP is stable). Procurement also asked that we include the PO workflow in the SOW appendix.

We can do Tue 2 Jul at 11am PT.

Also: we will share the event JSON schema and a sample of the transcription payload by EOD tomorrow. Expect a separate email from our platform engineer, Jason (jason.liu@healthnest.com).

Roberto
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Implementation plan & kickoff invite (proposed) — HealthNest integration

Team —

Following up with a compact implementation plan and owners so everyone knows the asks before the kickoff. Please review and let me know if owners/dates need adjusting. I’ve attached a more formal SOW stub for procurement to start reviewing. Key points:

Deliverables (owners):
- MAP (mutual-action-plan.csv) — Grace/Monica (editable) — due 2028-06-27
- JSON schema crosswalk & canonical output spec — Jason (HealthNest) + Redwood schema owner (Marissa) — due 2028-07-06
- Streaming test harness (sample session & logs) — Monica (Redwood infra) — initial run 2028-07-10
- Tool-call integration smoke test (adjudication calls) — Eng owners (HealthNest + Redwood) — 2028-07-12
- Pilot run & monitoring dashboard — Monica/Marissa — 2028-07-20

Security & compliance: Grace will coordinate SOC2 evidence exchange and Marissa will collect runtime audit log requirements. Roberto, please confirm which firewall egress IPs your infra requires; we’ll add them to the SOW appendix.

Kickoff details: Tue 2 Jul 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET — 60m. Calendar invite to follow.

Attachments: onboarding-sow.pdf (SOW stub). Drive with templates: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bExampleSharedOnboarding

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
